policy.javascriptAndCssRule: floor(exact accepted TD-006 aggregate production bytes * 1.05)
policy.runtimeMediaRule: at most two new image-only runtime assets totaling at most 8 MiB above the exact accepted TD-006 media hash set
policy.browserTemporaryWorkspaceRule: session-only memory-backed relative-path workspace; one declared UTF-8 write and one declared UTF-8 read; destroyed in finally; no IndexedDB, OPFS, localStorage, sessionStorage, Cache API, service worker, download, external path, network, package, environment, process, or arbitrary Python execution
policy.truthfulExecutionLabel: The course validator executes the approved file-operation plan against an isolated session-only virtual temporary file; it does not execute arbitrary Python or contact a live service.

requiredQualityGates: runtime images remain maximum-quality cinematic photorealistic first-person world identities; byte caps never authorize visible degradation
each runtime image has direct import, emitted byte and SHA-256 identity, provenance, accessible alternative treatment, responsive crops, grayscale review, and explicit placeholder retirement
the two accepted source masters remain separately counted from private generation attempts and runtime derivatives

the browser-safe PY-015 workspace remains memory-only, relative-path-only, UTF-8, one-write/one-read, cleanup-proven, private-free, and truthfully labeled as approved-plan execution rather than arbitrary Python execution
learner source, report content, restored report, filename work state, raw cases, answers, feedback, and diagnostics are never placed in durable persistence
every emitted JavaScript and CSS chunk is aggregated
every runtime media file is counted and classified by SHA-256 against the accepted TD-006 set
all accepted TD-006 runtime media identities remain present
new runtime audio, font, video, source-map, Python/WASM runtime, and network payloads are rejected
focused, related, full, validator, build, served identity, non-overlapping E2E, responsive/accessibility review, fixture exclusion, QA restoration, and as-built reconciliation remain mandatory
quality, learning evidence, privacy, sanitation, accessibility, responsive behavior, save/recovery, offline behavior, and invariant-world limits cannot be reduced to meet a cap
